hints.text: A fraction and a division problem are two ways of writing the same thing. Think about what the fraction bar means.
The number being divided goes on top as the numerator. The number you divide by goes on the bottom as the denominator.
With $3$ on top and $4$ on the bottom, $3 \div 4 = \frac{3}{4}$.

explanation: A fraction means the top number divided by the bottom number, so any division can be written as a fraction.
Here $3$ is being split into $4$ equal parts, so $3$ is the numerator and $4$ is the denominator.
That gives $3 \div 4 = \frac{3}{4}$, which is three fourths.

alternativeExplanations.title: Picture it
steps: Imagine $3$ granola bars shared by $4$ friends.
Cut each bar into $4$ pieces — that is $12$ pieces, and each friend takes $3$ of them.
$3$ pieces out of the $4$ that make one bar is $\frac{3}{4}$ of a bar ✓
